title: FrameFlagService
responsibility: Stores version-bound frame flags durably and supplies unresolved image feedback to the owning unit.

inputs.name: FrameFlagService.constructor.root
inputs.description: Repository used for source notes, immutable evidence and retained frame objects. The documented default is the source expression process.cwd(), evaluated by the implementation; it is not a literal string value.

inputs.name: FrameFlagService.constructor.reader
inputs.description: Exact-reference reader. The default follows attached verified evidence; injected readers must satisfy the same runtime binding checks. The documented default is the source expression defaultAttachedReader, evaluated by the implementation; it is not a literal string value.

inputs.name: FrameFlagService.flag.input
inputs.description: Attached clip reference, exact frame position and optional reviewer note/region.

inputs.name: FrameFlagService.list.unit
inputs.description: Stable registered unit identity used to scope the lookup.

inputs.name: FrameFlagService.list.current
inputs.description: Current slot hashes used to distinguish stale feedback without removing its history.

inputs.name: FrameFlagService.feedback.unit
inputs.description: Stable registered unit identity used to scope the lookup.

inputs.name: FrameFlagService.feedback.directory
inputs.description: Task-owned input directory where exact hash-verified reviewer PNGs are materialized; caller supplies and owns the directory.

inputs.name: FrameFlagService.frame.unit
inputs.description: Stable registered unit identity used to scope the lookup.

inputs.name: FrameFlagService.frame.id
inputs.description: Id supplied to FrameFlagService.frame under its declared string contract.

inputs.name: FrameFlagService.address.reference
inputs.description: Immutable attached record/revision plus the owning unit, clip and viewport.

inputs.name: defaultAttachedReader.reference
inputs.description: Exact original attached parent and clip slot requested for frame feedback.

inputs.name: defaultAttachedReader.root
inputs.description: Project checkout used for immutable source and evidence reads. The documented default is the source expression process.cwd(), evaluated by the implementation; it is not a literal string value.

inputs.name: defaultAttachedReader.pinned
inputs.description: Optional fixed evidence and notes snapshot; supplied bounds are never widened. Omission passes undefined; the implementation applies the documented optional behavior.

inputs.name: inspectFrameClip.clip
inputs.description: Claimed clip bytes and provenance; schema, integrity and decoded facts are checked before admission.

inputs.name: extractFlagFrame.clip
inputs.description: Claimed clip bytes and provenance; schema, integrity and decoded facts are checked before admission.

inputs.name: extractFlagFrame.frameNumber
inputs.description: Zero-based decoded frame index within the retained clip interval.

inputs.name: inspectFlagPng.bytes
inputs.description: Retained bytes inspected against their declared type, size and integrity.

inputs.name: materializeFlagFrame.root
inputs.description: Project checkout used for immutable source, evidence and tool reads.

inputs.name: materializeFlagFrame.flag
inputs.description: The exact retained reviewer flag and its version-bound frame.

inputs.name: materializeFlagFrame.directory
inputs.description: Task-owned directory containing the capture or retained receipt files.

inputs.name: retainedFlagFrame.root
inputs.description: Project checkout used for immutable source, evidence and tool reads.

inputs.name: retainedFlagFrame.flag
inputs.description: The exact retained reviewer flag and its version-bound frame.

inputs.name: parseFlagValue.schema
inputs.description: Runtime schema whose output type is admitted only after validation.

inputs.name: parseFlagValue.value
inputs.description: Typed caller value revalidated by the supplied schema; JavaScript and injected readers do not bypass runtime validation.

inputs.name: parseFlagJson.schema
inputs.description: Runtime schema whose output type is admitted only after validation.

inputs.name: parseFlagJson.bytes
inputs.description: Raw JSON bytes; unknown parsed data stays private until the supplied schema accepts it. Missing, malformed or rejected input fails closed.

inputs.name: frameHash.bytes
inputs.description: Retained bytes inspected against their declared type, size and integrity.

inputs.name: boundClip.reference
inputs.description: Immutable attached record/revision plus the owning unit, clip and viewport.

inputs.name: boundClip.value
inputs.description: FrameClip returned under the reader contract; exact requested identity, byte cap and hash are still independently validated.

inputs.name: framePosition.input
inputs.description: Attached clip reference, exact frame position and optional reviewer note/region.

inputs.name: framePosition.facts
inputs.description: Decoded cadence, duration, dimensions and retained frame count.

inputs.description: Immutable attached record/revision plus the owning unit, clip and viewport.

inputs.description: Immutable attached record/revision plus the owning unit, clip and viewport.

inputs.name: addressedFlags.flags

inputs.description: Immutable attached record/revision plus the owning unit, clip and viewport.

inputs.description: Project checkout used for immutable source, evidence and tool reads.

inputs.name: storeFrameFlag.flag
inputs.description: The exact retained reviewer flag and its version-bound frame.

inputs.description: Project checkout used for immutable source, evidence and tool reads.

inputs.name: storeFrameResolution.flag
inputs.description: The exact retained reviewer flag and its version-bound frame.

inputs.name: storeFrameResolution.clip

inputs.name: readFlagFrame.root
inputs.description: Project checkout used for immutable source, evidence and tool reads.

inputs.name: readFlagFrame.flag

inputs.name: readFrameCapture.root

inputs.name: readFrameCapture.reference
inputs.description: Exact original attached parent, tested source, owner, clip and viewport.

inputs.name: readFrameCapture.pinned
inputs.description: Immutable evidence and notes commits; null refuses unavailable evidence or notes. Omission passes undefined; the implementation applies the documented optional behavior.

outputs.name: FrameFlagService.run
outputs.description: The string result of FrameFlagService.run.

outputs.name: FrameFlagService.flag
outputs.description: Persisted active reviewer flag with exact source/record/clip/frame identity and a hash-verified extracted PNG; no source commit is changed.

outputs.name: FrameFlagService.list
outputs.description: Only this owner’s retained flags, with immutable replacement proof replayed before resolved status is accepted; supplied current hashes may mark unresolved feedback stale.

outputs.name: FrameFlagService.feedback
outputs.description: Unresolved reviewer text, flag identities and exact materialized PNG paths for this owner; corrupt or missing frames reject the feedback assembly.

outputs.name: FrameFlagService.frame
outputs.description: Exact retained PNG bytes for this owner and flag ID after bounded regular-file, hash and PNG validation.

outputs.name: FrameFlagService.address
outputs.description: Reviewer flags explicitly addressed by an attached verified replacement captured strictly after each flag; immutable resolution events preserve prior feedback history.

outputs.name: defaultAttachedReader
outputs.description: Original clip identity, timing, dimensions and verified bytes for exact frame extraction.

outputs.name: inspectFrameClip
outputs.description: The FrameVideoFacts result of inspectFrameClip.

outputs.name: extractFlagFrame
outputs.description: The Buffer result of extractFlagFrame.

outputs.name: inspectFlagPng
outputs.description: The unknown result of inspectFlagPng.

outputs.name: materializeFlagFrame
outputs.description: The Promise<string> result of materializeFlagFrame.

outputs.name: retainedFlagFrame
outputs.description: The Promise<Buffer> result of retainedFlagFrame.

outputs.name: ownerSchema
outputs.description: The unknown result of ownerSchema.

outputs.name: referenceSchema
outputs.description: The unknown result of referenceSchema.

outputs.name: inputSchema
outputs.description: The unknown result of inputSchema.

outputs.name: storedFlagSchema
outputs.description: The unknown result of storedFlagSchema.

outputs.name: resolutionSchema
outputs.description: The unknown result of resolutionSchema.

outputs.name: currentSchema
outputs.description: The unknown result of currentSchema.

outputs.name: parseFlagValue
outputs.description: The T result of parseFlagValue.

outputs.name: parseFlagJson
outputs.description: The unknown result of parseFlagJson.

outputs.name: frameHash
outputs.description: The string result of frameHash.

outputs.name: boundClip
outputs.description: The FrameClip result of boundClip.

outputs.name: framePosition
outputs.description: The unknown result of framePosition.

outputs.name: sameFrameSlot
outputs.description: The boolean result of sameFrameSlot.

outputs.name: addressedFlags
outputs.description: The FrameFlag[] result of addressedFlags.

outputs.name: owningFrameCapture
outputs.description: The Capture result of owningFrameCapture.

outputs.name: storeFrameFlag
outputs.description: The Promise<FrameFlag> result of storeFrameFlag.

outputs.name: readFrameFlags
outputs.description: The Promise<FrameFlag[]> result of readFrameFlags.

outputs.name: storeFrameResolution
outputs.description: The Promise<void> result of storeFrameResolution.

outputs.name: readFlagFrame
outputs.description: The Promise<Buffer> result of readFlagFrame.

outputs.name: readFrameCapture
outputs.description: Selected admitted capture metadata and bounded verified video bytes; archived siblings are not loaded.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Invalid owner/reference/schema, out-of-range frame, unavailable or corrupt bounded media, or an unproved/older replacement rejects without clearing reviewer obligations.
